description: Official UK company check from the Companies House register. Look up by company number (exact) or search by name (up to 5 candidates). Returns official name, status (active/dissolved/liquidation), type, incorporation and cessation dates, registered office, SIC codes, and the register's insolvency-history and charges flags, with a direct Companies House link. Companies only.

company_number.description: UK company number (exact), e.g. 08804411; provide this or 'name'

name.description: Company name to search (up to 5 candidates)

name: check_uk_company
